name: Add Layer
description: Adds a new shape or vector layer to the active crosshair

name: Update Layer
description: Modifies properties, transform, paint, or effects of a layer

name: Remove Layer
description: Deletes a layer from the active crosshair

name: Reorder Layer
description: Changes the stack position of a layer

name: Duplicate Layer
description: Creates an exact clone of the target layer

name: Rename Layer
description: Renames a reticle layer

name: Group Layers
description: Groups selected layers into a named layer group

name: Ungroup Layers
description: Dissolves a layer group back into individual layers

name: Set Layer Position
description: Sets exact X/Y position in game pixels (relative or absolute)

name: Recenter Selection
description: Moves selected layers back to reticle center (0, 0)

name: Recenter Crosshair
description: Resets whole crosshair global offset back to (0, 0)

name: Set Reticle Color
description: Sets reticle fill color using hex format (#RRGGBBAA)

name: Set Selection
description: Selects specified layers

name: Add to Selection
description: Adds layers to active selection

name: Remove from Selection
description: Removes layers from active selection

name: Toggle Selection
description: Toggles layer selection status

name: Select All
description: Selects all layers in the active reticle

name: Clear Selection
description: Clears current layer selection

name: Invert Selection
description: Inverts current layer selection

name: List Groups
description: Lists all crosshair groups and game bindings

name: Create Group
description: Creates a new crosshair group collection

name: Rename Group
description: Renames a crosshair group

name: Delete Group
description: Deletes a crosshair group and manages member crosshairs

name: Reorder Groups
description: Reorders library crosshair groups

name: Set Group Icon
description: Sets the display icon or color dot for a crosshair group

name: Add to Group
description: Adds crosshairs to a group collection

name: Remove from Group
description: Removes crosshairs from a group to Ungrouped

name: Set Game Binding
description: Links a group to a game executable process name for auto-switch

name: Set Group Resolution Profile
description: Assigns a default resolution profile to a group

name: Set Group Active Crosshair
description: Remembers the active reticle for a group

name: Next in Group
description: Cycles to the next crosshair in the active group

name: Previous in Group
description: Cycles to the previous crosshair in the active group

name: Activate Group
description: Activates a group and its active crosshair onto the overlay

name: Export Pack
description: Exports a group as a .xhairpack bundle archive

name: Import Pack
description: Imports a .xhairpack bundle archive into the library

name: Set Global Transform
description: Updates master scale, opacity, and rotation of the crosshair

name: Set Symmetry
description: Configures crosshair rotational and reflectional symmetry

name: Set Effects
description: Applies composite effects (glow, shadow, bloom, blur)

name: Nudge Selection
description: Fine nudges crosshair, layer, or arm in game pixels

name: Batch Edit
description: Executes multiple command mutations atomically in one undo step

name: Undo
description: Undoes the last applied mutation on the active crosshair

name: Redo
description: Redoes the previously undone mutation

name: List Crosshairs
description: Queries all crosshair definitions stored in the local catalog

name: Create Crosshair
description: Initializes a new crosshair from a template

name: Duplicate Crosshair
description: Clones an entire crosshair in the library catalog

name: Delete Crosshair
description: Moves a crosshair to the 30-day trash lifecycle

name: Rename Crosshair
description: Updates the display name of a crosshair document

name: Set Crosshair Metadata
description: Updates author, tags, description, and favorite status

name: Toggle Overlay Visibility
description: Shows or hides the Win32 click-through overlay window

name: Activate Overlay Crosshair
description: Sets the live crosshair rendered on the overlay window

name: Next Crosshair
description: Cycles overlay to the next crosshair in the library

name: Previous Crosshair
description: Cycles overlay to the previous crosshair in the library

name: Show Calibration Grid
description: Displays the subpixel calibration crosshair pattern

name: Export Share Code
description: Exports crosshair as compressed Brotli share code

name: Import Share Code
description: Parses and validates a compressed Brotli share code

name: Import Valorant Code
description: Parses an in-game Valorant crosshair string into native layers

name: Render Preview
description: Renders the crosshair into a pixel-accurate PNG preview

name: Analyze Alignment
description: Computes centering and pixel boundary parity report

name: Analyze Visibility
description: Calculates WCAG contrast against game backdrop samples

name: Validate Document
description: Validates crosshair structure against schema limits

name: Get Capabilities
description: Returns available subsystems, tools, and runtime mode

name: Get Shortcuts
description: Lists all registered hotkeys and command palette entries

name: Show Calibration Pattern
description: Shows the full-screen calibration alignment pattern overlay

name: Hide Calibration Pattern
description: Hides the calibration alignment pattern overlay

name: Set Calibration Offset
description: Sets the physical pixel calibration offset in game pixels

name: List Properties
description: Lists all schema-driven micro properties with metadata and filters

name: Get Property
description: Retrieves current value of a property by descriptor ID

name: Set Property
description: Sets a single property value by descriptor ID

name: Set Multiple Properties
description: Atomically updates multiple properties across layers

name: Reset Property
description: Resets a property or group back to descriptor default

name: Link Properties
description: Toggles link state between paired properties

name: Search Properties
description: Searches property registry by name, label, tip, or keywords

name: Copy Style
description: Copies stroke, fill, and effects style from target layer

name: Paste Style
description: Applies copied style attributes onto selected layers

name: Save Style Preset
description: Saves current layer style configuration as a reusable preset

name: Apply Style Preset
description: Applies a named style preset to selected layers

name: List Style Presets
description: Lists all saved and default style presets

name: Delete Style Preset
description: Deletes a saved style preset

name: Randomize Crosshair
description: Generates bounded random variations of the crosshair

name: List Themes
description: Lists all 9 neutral-base application themes

name: Get Theme
description: Gets current application theme ID and base ramp

name: Set Theme
description: Switches active application theme

name: Preview Theme
description: Temporarily previews a theme without saving

name: Get Appearance
description: Returns full appearance configuration (theme, font, corner style)

name: Set Appearance
description: Updates theme, system sync, font pack, corner style, and density

name: List Font Packs
description: Lists all 6 bundled self-hosted WOFF2 typography packs

name: Open Dock Panel
description: Opens a panel tab in specified dock area

name: Close Dock Panel
description: Closes a panel tab without deleting underlying data

name: Move Dock Panel
description: Moves a panel tab between dock areas (left, right, bottom)

name: Split Dock Panel
description: Splits dock area horizontally or vertically with target panel

name: Float Dock Panel
description: Floats a panel tab as an in-app mini window over canvas

name: Detach Dock Panel
description: Detaches a dock panel into a separate OS window

name: Pin Dock Panel
description: Pins or unpins a floating dock panel

name: Maximize Dock Panel
description: Maximizes panel within its dock area

name: List Dock Layouts
description: Lists saved dock layout presets (Compact, Pixel Art, Designer, Agent Watch)

name: Save Dock Layout
description: Saves current dock arrangement as a named layout preset

name: Apply Dock Layout
description: Applies a saved dock layout preset

name: Reset Dock Layout
description: Resets dock arrangement to default layout

name: Export Dock Layout
description: Exports dock layout configuration JSON

name: Import Dock Layout
description: Imports dock layout configuration JSON
